message.content:
Women's tank tops of man-made fibers, knitted, fall under HTS 6109.90.10 ("T-shirts, singlets, tank tops... knitted or crocheted: of other textile materials"). Cotton would be 6109.10, and man-made fibers are 6109.90.

Within 6109.90, the subheadings are:
- 6109.90.10 – Of man-made fibers (statistical suffixes 6109.90.1000 etc.)
- 6109.90.20 – Of wool or fine animal hair
- 6109.90.40 – Of silk blends, etc.

In the current HTSUS, 6109.90.10 is "Of man-made fibers," with 10-digit numbers 6109.90.1004 (men's/boys'), 6109.90.1007 (women's/girls', "Tank tops"?), 6109.90.1009, 6109.90.1011... I recall that for 6109.90.10 the statistical suffixes are 6109.90.1006 men's/boys', 6109.90.1008 women's/girls'... In CBP rulings, women's polyester tank tops are classified as 6109.90.1008 for "Women's or girls'" subheading. I'll go with 6109.90.1008.
